scope: Bounded read-only source and existing artifact audit. No harvesting, training, inference, oracle execution or source mutation.

christoffel.state: Full producer export and both associated evidence files are tracked in HEAD; distinct from the separately promoted ergentics-logic subset.
christoffel.semantics: Negative labels mark rejected candidate words. The recorded answer no is the correct classification for the question, not an intentionally wrong answer. Preserve all 763 no rows. Generic negative-to-WRONG-ANSWER rendering would corrupt this family's semantics.
christoffel.eligibility: Raw preservation now; any training projection must use an explicit family-specific classification adapter and separate split policy. This audit does not recertify oracle independence.

methodScaffolds.eligibility: Existing retrieval sidecar with method notes, not question-answer training records. Do not fabricate questions or targets.

oracleIndependenceEmitter.negativeSemantics: Unlike Christoffel, negativeTrap intentionally proposes the wrong independent answer for coupled input.

connections: AgentcraftKit depends on the frozen local MasteryKit package; AgentContractKit remains a separate pure-predicate target.
ScaffoldStore retrieves the committed MethodScaffold JSONL. Applying notes to model context does not update model weights.

AgentcraftMLX uses a separate MLX/Hugging Face model and chat-template path; its default demo is Llama 3.2 1B. No compatible native Prime checkpoint or SentencePiece training output was found in this bounded repository inventory.
The documented circular-reasoner seam is a future verifier-model integration point. Its acid-test fixture-fitted stand-in is explicitly not a general learned detector.
Commit 37bcc4d, merged by current HEAD, retracts GeometryLock and GeometryMint stand-ins. Deleted stand-ins must not be revived as accepted mathematics.
recommendation: Register corpus, sidecar, implementation and evidence as distinct file roles; retain original bytes and label semantics. Connect existing raw exports now, then select a reviewed, family-specific training projection later. Keep model weights and tokenizer unchanged.
